name: energetic
label: Energetic
css: .style-energetic { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FFEDD5 0%, #FDBA74 100%); border: 4px solid #EA580B; border-radius: 0; padding: 64px 48px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; height: 100%; position: relative; overflow: hidden; font-family: 'Limelight', serif; } .style-energetic::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: -40%; right: -10%; width: 600px; height: 600px; background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.15) 0%, transparent 70%); border-radius: 50%; z-index: 0; } .style-energetic .hook { font-family: 'Limelight', serif; font-size: 80px; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.1; color: #EA580C; position: relative; z-index: 1; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: -2px; } .style-energetic .text { font-family: 'Limelight', serif; font-size: 50px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.2; color: #EA580C; position: relative; z-index: 1; margin-top: 24px; } .style-energetic .step { position: absolute; top: 48px; right: 48px; font-size: 160px; font-weight: 900; color: #EA580C; opacity: 0.08; z-index: 0; font-family: 'Limelight', serif; } .style-energetic .brand { position: absolute; bottom: 48px; left: 48px; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 400; color: #EA580C; letter-spacing: 2px; z-index: 1; text-transform: uppercase; } .slide-code.style-energetic { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1a1a1a 0%, #2d2d2d 100%); border: 4px solid #EA580B; } .slide-code.style-energetic .hook, .slide-code.style-energetic .text, .slide-code.style-energetic .brand, .slide-code.style-energetic .step { color: #FFA500; } .slide-insight.style-energetic { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1a1a1a 0%, #2d2d2d 100%); border: 4px solid #F59E0B; } .slide-insight.style-energetic .hook, .slide-insight.style-energetic .text, .slide-insight.style-energetic .brand, .slide-insight.style-energetic .step { color: #F59E0B; } .slide-insight.style-energetic .insight-text { font-size: 24px; color: #F59E0B; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4; }
